description: The only operations the constrained network assistant may select. Each handler is deterministic backend code; the model never receives database access.

tools.name: checkServiceability
tools.description: Check whether an identified enclosure can serve a customer at a given location. Return deterministic serviceability issues such as no spare core, no available splitter port, or insufficient optical power margin. Read-only.

enclosure_id.description: The existing enclosure ID to check. Do not invent an ID.

lat.description: Customer latitude, when the location is available as coordinates.

lng.description: Customer longitude, when the location is available as coordinates.

tools.name: findPortRemediation
tools.description: Find deterministic ways to resolve a missing or unavailable splitter port at an existing enclosure, using documented network capacity. Read-only; do not claim that any port was assigned or changed.

enclosure_id.description: The existing enclosure where port capacity is unavailable.

tools.name: findPowerRemediation
tools.description: Find deterministic remediation options for insufficient optical power margin on a documented fiber path. Read-only; return the calculated evidence and options without changing network records.

core_id.description: The existing fiber-core ID whose optical path has the power-margin issue.

enclosure_id.description: The existing enclosure at which a local remediation should be evaluated, when known.

tools.name: findCoreRemediation
tools.description: Find the nearest documented enclosure with spare fiber capacity and return the ordered connected cable path back to the target enclosure. This is the existing BFS-based capacity search, not a write.

enclosure_id.description: The existing target enclosure that needs a spare core.

exclude_self.description: Whether the target enclosure itself should be excluded as a source; defaults to true.

tools.name: traceCore
tools.description: Trace an existing fiber core through documented cables, splices, mid-span continuations, splitter crossings, and customer termination. Read-only.

core_id.description: The existing fiber-core ID to trace.

tools.name: simulateFailure
tools.description: Simulate failure of an existing enclosure and report the deterministic downstream fiber, box, cable, and customer impact. This never changes the database and does not simulate a cable or pole failure.

enclosure_id.description: The existing enclosure to simulate as failed.

tools.name: locateCustomer
tools.description: Build a deterministic physical connection plan for a customer location, including the nearest enclosure, exact available port or core choice, source path when capacity must be brought in, route basis, and optical budget. Read-only.

address.description: Customer street address, when coordinates are not available.

lat.description: Customer latitude. Provide with lng when using coordinates.

lng.description: Customer longitude. Provide with lat when using coordinates.

radius_m.description: Maximum search radius in metres for candidate enclosures.

route.description: Whether to request a street route when the route service is configured.

tools.name: lookupDocs
tools.description: Retrieve the most relevant approved Fiberline documentation chunks for a software or network-operations question. Use retrieved documentation rather than model memory; read-only.

query.description: The user's documentation or how-to question in plain language.

top_k.description: Number of documentation chunks to retrieve, from 1 to 3; defaults to 3.
